name: 時刻を添えた会話吹き出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH03-0002「時刻を添えた会話吹き出し」.
Reference priority: Image 1 ORIGINAL controls bubble anatomy, corner/tail shape, time/check alignment and icon glyph geometry/proportions/stroke optical weight. Image 2 our mock is SECONDARY for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy rough mock substitute icons or invented states. Image 3 is approved Lighthouse styling only.
Single outgoing chat bubble, with a subtle short lower-right tail as in the original. Pure white #FFFFFF canvas and white bubble surface, fine neutral outline with a restrained forest-green edge as the outgoing-direction cue; small soft downward shadow. No broad mint fill or chat wallpaper. Keep the compact original bubble's relationship between paragraph and lower-right time plus ONE sent-check glyph. The source original shows a SINGLE check; our mock's double check must NOT be copied because it invents a read state.
Text verbatim, exactly THREE lines:
みなさん、お久しぶりです。
来週の予定が決まったら、
この会話で教えてください。
Below, lower right: 12:16 followed by one slim familiar check mark adapted from the ORIGINAL, in forest green. No second check. Body #1D1D1D, time #6E6E6E. No other labels or text.
Preserve verified native typography and compact proportions: logical bubble 300px wide about112px tall, body Meiryo Regular14px/24px, time Meiryo Regular12px/16px, tracking0. Paragraph inset12px. Body deliberately regular, not bold. Preserve these size relationships under uniform enlargement. Output landscape 3:2, one generously readable bubble at center with modest white margins. No device frame, header, compose field, duplicated bubbles, buttons, English or invented features.
Color decision: original pale green indicates outgoing direction; adapt this meaningful distinction to a fine green edge/tail and green sent check while retaining an ordinary white surface. Do not add a primary action where none exists. Clear hierarchy, complete Japanese glyphs, clean alignment and restrained depth.
reviewNotes: 原画像を形状・線幅・尾部・送信状態の主参照、保存モックを日本語内容の副参照として実入力。原画像の単一チェックに修正し、モックの二重チェックを採用しない。送信方向を示す緑は細い縁とチェックへ適応、白面を維持。実画像で日本語3行と12:16、単一チェック、尾部、欠落・クリップなしを目視。厳密なフォント計測、編集可能性・送信動作・所有者承認は未確定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
